was a missed opportunity; finally I decided to do somethi ng about it. The weapons available from the campaign start, Tiger tanks, 17K18, FW190, etc., give the opportunity of having a high pace, strong power fight. Most of the casualties in WWII occurred in the Russian front (3/5 of all others combined). Therefore, I devoted most scenarios to this theater of operations. The fighting was also extremely violent and continuous. I tried t o reflect this in my scenarios.
column3: 是错失的良机；最后我决定为此做点什么。战役一开始就能拿到的武器——虎式坦克、17K18、FW190 等——让人有机会打一场快节奏、火力强劲的仗。此外，从历史上看，最激烈的战斗大多发生在战役所涵盖的时期(1942 年末至 1945 年末)。二战中的伤亡大多出现在俄国战线(占其他所有战线合计的 3/5)。因此我把大多数场景都放在这个战区。那里的战斗也极其猛烈而连续。我尽力在场景中反映这一点。

column2: The action will take you from France to the Volga and from Finland to North Africa. You will experience all kind of terrains and weathers also. I have decided not to use any custom-made map in order to be able to fit all the files in a floppy diskette. Several scenarios can be improved significantly by using some of the new maps. Most of them were not available at the time I started the campaign either. I started with the Zerstore equipment. I found better ones later on, but I could not change it without changing significantly the scenarios. The equipment file is provided. Version 2 of the campaign will include new maps and a different equipment file.
column3: 战斗会把你从法国带到伏尔加河，从芬兰带到北非。你还会经历各种地形和天气。为了让所有文件能装进一张软盘，我决定不使用任何自制地图。有几个场景如果改用一些新地图，能有明显改善。我刚开始做战役时，它们大多也还不存在。我最初用的是 Zerstore 装备。后来我找到了更好的，但一换就会让场景发生很大变化，所以没法改。装备文件已随附。战役第 2 版将包含新地图和另一份装备文件。

column2: A military government was es tablished in Germany after the assassination of Hitler by the end of 1942. This government closed the death camps, imprisoned the Nazi hierarchy, improved the conditions in the occupied territories and transformed the concentration camps in labor camps w i th tough, but livable conditions. The Nazi party was completely outlawed. After these necessary measurements negotiations were established with the Allies for a peace treaty based on the German border of 1914 plus Austria and the Sudetenland. The Allie s rejected these conditions and demanded immediate surrender plus the dismemberment of Germany. Negotiations broke off and the war continued. The military government was well aware that the war situation was very delicate. Therefore, a new strategy was a dopted. A new army provided with the best and more experienced men and the best available weapons was created. This army was to be progressively built into a superb fighting machine. This army's mission was to make things so tough for the Allies that t h ey will agree to a negotiated settlement. As this army grows and the other forces get defeated it becomes the only important military force for the Axis. This army (later an army group) will be the last significant force left to defend the Fatherland. The General Staff looked for a brilliant, young General to build and handle this superb tool of war. You, Herr General, are the chosen one of the General Staff. The fate of a united Germany going into the 21
column3: 1942 年底希特勒被刺杀后，德国建立了一个军政府。这个政府关闭了死亡营，囚禁了纳粹高层，改善了占领区的状况，并把集中营改造成条件艰苦但尚可居住的劳动营。纳粹党被彻底取缔。采取这些必要措施之后，德国开始与盟国谈判，希望以 1914 年的德国边界加上奥地利和苏台德地区为基础签订和约。盟国拒绝了这些条件，要求德国立即投降并肢解德国。谈判破裂，战争继续。军政府很清楚战局非常微妙。因此采取了新战略：组建一支新军队，配备最优秀、最有经验的人员和能拿到的最好武器。这支军队将逐步打造成一台出色的战争机器。它的任务是把盟国逼到难以承受的地步，使他们同意通过谈判解决问题。随着这支军队壮大、其他部队被击败，它成为轴心国唯一重要的军事力量。这支军队(后来是一个集团军群)将是保卫祖国所剩的最后一支重要力量。总参谋部要找一位才华出众的年轻将军来组建并指挥这件出色的战争工具。将军阁下，你就是总参谋部选中的人。一个统一的德国能否走进 21

column2: The campaign contains 31 scenarios divided in upper and lower paths. The first is common to both. After the first, the upper path contains 15 scenarios while the lower one also 15. There are n ot two scenarios identical and most of them are completely different, even the ones depicting the same battle. After the first scenario you follow one or the other path depending on your battlefield results. A victory or a brilliant victory will keep yo u in the upper path. A loss or a tactical victory will send you into the lower. You can come back to the upper path by a brilliant victory. You enter into an upper path scenario depending on the timetable of the campaign, i.e., the following battle acco r ding to date. In this way you may be sent back and forth between the two paths. Any victory is enough to remain in the lower path, but a loss in the lower path will put you out of the campaign. The only exceptions are Mussolini's Rescue and Sevastopol E vacuation, were you continue whatever your result is. These scenarios are especial mission scenarios. The victory should be achieved following an especially prepared strategy. Some players may miss them. It will be no fun to be thrown out of the campa ign for failing to discover them. By the way, I was never able to win a brilliant victory in Mussolini's Rescue and I prepared it!!!
column3: 本战役包含 31 个场景，分为上部与下部两条路径。第一个场景为两条路径共有。第一个之后，上部路径有 15 个场景，下部路径也有 15 个。没有哪两个场景是相同的，大多数场景完全不同，即使是描绘同一场战斗的场景也一样。打完第一个场景后，你根据战场结果走其中一条路径。胜利或辉煌胜利会让你留在上部路径。失败或战术胜利会把你送入下部路径。靠一次辉煌胜利你可以回到上部路径。你进入哪个上部路径场景取决于战役时间表，也就是按日期顺序的下一个战斗。这样你可能会在两条路径之间来回调动。在下部路径，任何胜利都足以留下，但在下部路径失败就会让你退出战役。唯一的例外是墨索里尼营救和塞瓦斯托波尔撤退，无论结果如何你都会继续。这两个是特殊任务场景。要取胜必须按专门准备的策略来打。有些玩家可能会错过它们。因为没能发现它们而被踢出战役可不好玩。顺便说一句，我在墨索里尼营救里从来没能拿到辉煌胜利，而它是我设计的！！！

column2: Practically any scenario is an original one; therefore, you may like to play all of them. I have prepared one linear campa ign file, Reich Defense Lower for strong players to play the lower path. In the linear campaign after a common first scenario you play one path scenario after the other.
column3: 几乎每个场景都是原创的；所以你也许会想把它们全都玩一遍。我为实力强的玩家准备了一个线性战役文件 Reich Defense Lower，用来打下部路径。在这个线性战役里，打完共有的第一个场景后，你就一个接一个地打该路径的场景。

column2: This campaign is tough, the first time I play-tested it I barely made it to general (220) and I reloaded several times because I wanted to finish the scenarios!!! I got for the lower path 6 BV, 8 V and 2 TV. I recommend average-below average players to start with the lower path at 100-150%.
column3: 本战役很难。我第一次试玩时勉强打到将军(220)，而且因为想把场景打完，重读了好几次！！！在下部路径我拿到 6 个 BV、8 个 V 和 2 个 TV。我建议水平中等偏下的玩家从下部路径、100-150% 开始。

column2: This campaign has b een designed to reflect fast pace, heavy and continuous action. Sevastopol Evacuation is an extreme example of this. You will lose more units in its 4-5 turns than in several other campaigns. The armies are also significantly stronger than in reality. We all know the AI plays awful, so I have to change the scenarios in a way it can at least play a decent game. All the scenarios contain many over strengthened units, entrenchment, leaders, etc. The percentage increases up to almost 100% in the last sce n ario. In many scenarios the player will be allowed to deploy only a fraction of its army. The auxiliary units are very important because they contribute to the balance of power and at the same time provide some sorely needed capabilities. At the same t i me the game becomes more realistic. Successful campaign play requires minimum casualties or you will be out pretty soon. This fact leads to neglect of the auxiliary units and excessive caution concerning the core units. Here you cannot neglect your aux iliary units. You will need every single one of them or you will not win. I regularly reinforced them to keep them alive.
column3: 本战役的设计目标是体现快节奏、激烈而连续的战斗。塞瓦斯托波尔撤退是这方面的极端例子。你在它那 4-5 个回合里损失的单位会比在其他好几个战役里都多。双方的军队也都比现实中强大得多。我们都知道 AI 打得很糟，所以我必须调整场景，让它至少能打得像样。所有场景里都有许多超额强化的单位、工事、指挥官等。到最后一个场景时，这个百分比几乎提高到 100%。在许多场景里，玩家只被允许部署其军队的一部分。辅助单位非常重要，因为它们既有助于力量平衡，又提供了一些急需的能力。同时游戏也变得更真实。要成功打完战役，伤亡必须降到最低，否则你很快就会出局。这一事实会导致玩家忽视辅助单位、对核心单位过分谨慎。但在这里你不能忽视辅助单位。你每一个都需要，否则就赢不了。我经常给它们补充兵员，让它们活下来。

column2: I try to control the growth of the player's army, but in the upper campaign still it got too strong. I was more successful in the lower path. Given a choice I decided to go the way of power, i.e., for a stronger player's army an even stronger AI army.
column3: 我试图控制玩家军队的成长，但在上部战役里它还是变得太强。下部路径我控制得比较成功。既然可以选择，我决定走力量路线，也就是玩家军队越强，AI 军队就更强。

column2: I did all the work, so, I have taken the prerogative of designing the kind of scenarios I like, full of action, and fast pace even if that strains reality. I hated the Winter Storm scenario in the original SSI campaign when it takes forever for those Rumanian units to reach the last victory hex. I also do not like scenarios where after 3-4 turns you can put automatic pilot and coll ect a victory without any thinking. There are surprises lurking for you at every corner. In the lower path Budapest scenario the Russian player starts the game with 18 last models tanks. Then, it will receive some more as reinforcements.
column3: 所有活都是我干的，所以我行使特权，按自己的喜好设计场景：充满行动、节奏快，即使这样会偏离现实。我讨厌原版 SSI 战役里的冬季风暴场景，那些罗马尼亚单位要花上很久才能到达最后一个胜利格。我也不喜欢那种打完 3-4 个回合就能开自动挡、不用动脑就收下胜利的场景。每个角落都为你藏着惊喜。在下部路径的布达佩斯场景里，俄军玩家开局就有 18 辆最新型号的坦克。之后它还会得到一些作为补充兵员。

column2: A campaign is not complete without "mission-like" scenarios. Two have been designed Mussolini's rescue and Sevastopol evacuation. You also have several amphibian scenarios, where the player counterattacks an Allied landing. I also added an amphibian scenario where t he Axis does the attack.
column3: 没有“任务式”场景，战役就不完整。我设计了两个：墨索里尼营救和塞瓦斯托波尔撤退。另外还有几个两栖场景，玩家在其中反击盟军登陆。我还加了一个由轴心国发起进攻的两栖场景。

column2: One interesting concept used in this campaign is the idea of "defensive scenarios." There are several of these scenarios in the campaign. The main idea is, the player does not have neither victory nor supply objectives. In orde r to win the player has to keep all the victory objectives held by him at the beginning of the game. If some are lost the player has to retake them to win. Of course, the game is over if the player loses all of them. Mr. Lasse Jensen originally propose d this idea. It was implemented using his excellent editor. You set victory conditions for both players on the same hexes and then you make sure that at least one of your victory hexes is lost. I found out that 3-4 victory scenarios are the best number. One or two are practically lost from the beginning, and the other one-two is/are under very heavy attack. If you set the AI to attack mode and give adequate reinforcements you have a nice game. The lack of supply hexes is used to reduce the number of p layer units.
column3: 本战役采用的一个有趣概念是“防御场景”。战役里有好几个这样的场景。其核心思路是：玩家既没有胜利目标，也没有补给目标。要获胜，玩家必须守住开局时自己持有的全部胜利目标。如果丢掉了其中一些，就必须夺回来才能获胜。当然，如果全部丢掉，游戏就结束了。这个主意最初是 Lasse Jensen 先生提出的。它用他出色的编辑器实现。你把双方在同一批格上的胜利条件都设好，然后确保你自己的胜利格至少有一个会被夺走。我发现 3-4 个胜利格是最合适的数目。其中一两个基本上从开局就注定丢掉，另外一两个则遭到极其猛烈的进攻。如果你把 AI 设为进攻模式，并给它足够的补充兵员，就能得到一局好棋。缺少补给格则用来减少玩家单位的数量。

column2: This campaign is not a historical campaign. I have a lot of respect for people who try to reproduce history, but this is mostly a fictional campaign. Everybody knows how things ended and it was a good thing. I designed a movement, heavy and continuous action campaign. You start fighting from the first term and it will not be over until is over. I sincerely regret if you do not like this kind of scenarios, but everybody is entitled to his own taste.
column3: 本战役不是历史战役。我很尊重那些努力还原历史的人，但这个战役基本上是虚构的。大家都知道事情最后是怎么结束的，而那是件好事。我设计的是一个机动、激烈而连续的战役。你从第一回合就开始打，直到打完才会结束。如果你不喜欢这类场景，我真心感到遗憾，但每个人都有自己的口味。

column2: The ficti onal character of the campaign makes you fight a battle approximately every two months. The period in between battles is even smaller by the end of the campaign. Of course, in practice this is impossible even when in several of the last scenarios you ca n deploy only part of your army. There were many interesting battles in the last year of the war. Please allow for this designer's license.
column3: 战役的虚构性质使你大约每两个月就要打一仗。到战役后期，两场战斗之间的间隔更短。当然，这在现实中是不可能的，即使最后有几个场景里你只能部署部分军队。战争最后一年有许多有趣的战斗。请容许设计者有这样的自由发挥。

column2: This campaign is not an endorsement of any political idea or of war. War is one of the most regrettable human activities. Before discovering Panzerg2 I was a master level chess player. I see the game as a more "colorful" chess.
column3: 本战役并不为任何政治理念或战争背书。战争是人类最令人遗憾的活动之一。在发现 Panzerg2 之前，我是一名大师级国际象棋棋手。我把这个游戏看作一盘更“丰富多彩”的国际象棋。

column2: I have organized implicitly the two armies following these guidelines. The two armies are distributed in Corps, infantry a nd tank corps. A tank corps has 4-6 units, 3-4 are tanks the others are auxiliaries (anti-tanks, AD, etc.). Each infantry corps has 4-8 units. At least 3 are infantry units, the others are artillery, anti-tanks, AA, AD, etc. Every unit represents a di vision or division-like formation. Two German armies will eventually participate, the 3

column2: This campaign was inspired by the camp aign 7PanzerArmee by Mr. Dave Anderson, my appreciation goes to him. After I started the campaign I read the work of many others and it was a great help. Mr. Lasse Jensen, il Signore Oronzo and Herr Andreas Seidel come directly to my mind. I also appre ciate the work of so many others who have transformed war-gaming into an art form. Thank you for playing the campaign. I hope you have as much fun playing as I have designed it.
column3: 本战役的灵感来自 Dave Anderson 先生的战役 7PanzerArmee，在此向他致谢。开始做这个战役之后，我读了另外许多人的作品，它们帮了大忙。我直接想到的是 Lasse Jensen 先生、il Signore Oronzo 和 Andreas Seidel 先生。我也感谢其他众多把兵棋推演变成一种艺术形式的人。感谢你玩这个战役。希望你在玩的时候能和我设计时一样开心。
